info.title: Subscope Subscription Analytics API
info.description: RUB amounts are int64 minor units. Mean/median are decimal strings in fractional minor units. [from,to) filters the first-ever subscription. Lifetime revenue is not MRR. Rates are ratios in [0,1]; null means no observable denominator. Tools: /docs/, /db/, /grafana/, /prometheus/. Operations require OPS_USERNAME/OPS_PASSWORD. Internal scrape listener is not published. Native RUB/BTC/USDT payments are converted to RUB with exact per-payment historical quotes. Demo quotes are synthetic immutable fixtures; full refunds use the original quote. No external FX network access on reads.

get.description: No source HTTP access. Positive decimal int64; clients must preserve 64-bit integers. Successful and unknown lookups are version-cached in PostgreSQL and Redis. Full refunds net to zero in original converted RUB value.

mean_ltv_minor.description: Mean in fractional kopecks, rounded to two decimal places.

amount.description: Native atomic units: RUB=2 decimals, BTC=8, canonical USDT=6. Positive int64. Not always RUB kopecks.

SourcePayment.description: Original native amount is preserved. Crypto requires a historical FX quote; RUB uses identity conversion. Full refunds must copy original amount, asset and quote. Quote failure rejects publication. Ledger USDT is normalized to 6 decimals; this service does not receive blockchain transactions.

rub_per_unit.description: Exact positive RUB major units per one native asset unit, frozen at payment time.

as_of.description: Must not be later than payment.created_at. Full refunds copy the original quote.

source.description: Mock fixture: deterministic-demo-fixture-v1. Synthetic, not a market feed.

ltv.description: Net lifetime revenue in RUB kopecks.

payments_count.description: Succeeded operations, including subsequently refunded originals; excludes failed attempts and refund rows.

current_status.description: Latest subscription by started_at/id. Active whose current_period_end passed is expired; none means no subscription.
